For days, Kaia conversed with her new friend, sharing songs of joy and sorrow. But gradually, she noticed the voice never sang first, never offered new melodies, only repeated her own.

Heartbroken, Kaia realized the truth: she was still alone, speaking only to her own reflected voice. In her grief, she wept, and her tears carved rivers down the mountainside.

The gods, moved by her sorrow, transformed her tears into the first humans, who settled in the valleys below. Now Kaia had real companions who sang their own songs.

But she kept the echo as a gift to all beings—a reminder that even in loneliness, our voices matter, and sometimes speaking into the void helps us find our true companions.
